previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 生平著作年表：1905巴黎生与外祖父家、高师1924—29、agrégation第二次应试通过且波伏娃第二、勒阿弗尔1931-36、柏林1933前后发现现象学、《自我的超越性》1936、《恶心》1938、《存在与虚无》1943、《禁闭》1943/44首演、1945人道主义讲演、1948《什么是文学？》作家介入与自由、1960《辩证理性批判》、1964拒诺奖、1980卒与葬礼规模。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: Life and Works节（failed first agrégation, placed first on retaking, with Beauvoir second; Le Havre 1931–36, never held a university chair; apricot cocktail anecdote via Aron; year in Berlin studying Husserl, Heidegger, Scheler; captured 1940, meteorologist in Alsace; Nobel refusal 1964; Les Temps modernes; funeral 50,000–100,000）＋iepsartre（ENS 1924–1929 alongside Aron, Beauvoir, Merleau-Ponty; lycée Le Havre; grant to French Institute Berlin 1933; POW camp teaching Heidegger; declined Nobel 1964; no longer a Marxist 1977）

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 意向性与无内面意识、自在与自为、虚无与自由（被判定自由）、自欺（侍者例与弗洛伊德批判）、注视（钥匙孔例、羞耻、他人即冲突）、生存精神分析与基本谋划、实践惰性与熔合群体、作家介入与『作家只有一个主题：自由』。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: 各学说节（being which is what it is not; Pierre's absence; café waiter; Freud pseudo-explanation; keyhole scenario; 'The essence of the relations between consciousness is…conflict'; fundamental project; practico-inert, seriality, group in fusion; 'The writer only has one topic: freedom'）＋iepsartre（intentionality no inside; ego produced by reflection; look objectifies; authenticity coordinates transcendence and facticity; desire for being）

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 波伏娃1929契约与终生对话者及合葬（原创性之争并存）、胡塞尔先验自我批判与实在论意向性、梅洛-庞蒂同学与《人道主义与恐怖》借题、加缪《反抗者》1951-52决裂。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: 萨特相关段（met while studying for the agrégation in 1929, finished second to him; pact of 'essential lovers'; originality debates incl. whether B&N took from She Came to Stay; co-founded Les Temps Modernes; Adieux; buried with Sartre in Montparnasse 1986）＋sepsartre（Husserl transcendental ego rejected while preserving pre-reflective awareness; rupture with Camus 1951–52 over The Rebel; borrowed from Humanism and Terror）
